about.seo.title: About Raqim — A Luxury Digital Publishing House for Women
about.seo.description: Discover Raqim, the luxury digital publishing house for Arab women, and its mission to turn knowledge into a lasting legacy.
about.hero.title: Raqim: Where Knowledge Becomes a Lasting Legacy
about.hero.body: Raqim is a luxury Arabic digital publishing house, specializing in refined books and digital products. We believe every idea deserves to be documented, every book should leave a mark, and that timeless knowledge becomes Raqim.
about.story.title: Why Raqim?
about.story.bodyOne: The name Raqim is inspired by "al-raqim" — the inscribed record that preserves and safeguards knowledge across time. We founded this house to be a space where ideas become a lasting mark, and timeless knowledge becomes Raqim, through luxury digital books crafted with meticulous care — from the choice of every word to the smallest design detail.
about.story.bodyTwo: Our mission is to craft a reading experience that brings together beauty, depth, and Arab identity — offering works that leave a mark and accompany the reader through every stage of her journey.
about.values.title: What Guides Us
about.values.quality.title: Uncompromising Quality
about.values.quality.body: Every book goes through careful stages of editing and design before it reaches you.
about.values.honesty.title: Honesty in Every Word
about.values.honesty.body: We stay away from exaggeration, writing in an honest voice that speaks to your reality.
about.values.roots.title: Authentic Roots
about.values.roots.body: We draw inspiration from our Islamic and Arab heritage with a contemporary spirit.
about.values.legacy.title: A Lasting Impact
about.values.legacy.body: We design every release to be a companion you return to time and again.
